definitions.explanation: Prehistoric reptiles that dominated the Earth during the Mesozoic Era.

{恐竜|きょうりゅう} literally means "fearsome dragon" ({恐|きょう} = fear + ⟦{竜|りゅう}→竜：13766_ryuu⟧ = dragon). This is the standard word for all types of dinosaurs.
